title: R3 milestone 2 (STORY-037 to 042): security, accessibility and operations: evidence
capturedBy: scripts/evidence/r3-milestone-2.mjs on a local copy of the deployed code (screens 01 to 03 through the real pages)
summary: Synthetic demo deployment; not operating in production. Our own security testing, not a third-party penetration test.

shots.title: Recovery codes, shown once
shots.caption: Turning two-step verification on gives ten one-time codes, with copy and download; only their hashes are kept.

shots.title: Codes left, and new ones
shots.caption: Sign-in security counts the unused codes; new codes need a current code and stop the old ones working.

shots.title: Lost authenticator
shots.caption: The code step offers a recovery code instead; it works once and shares the five tries.

shots.title: The attack suite
shots.caption: Sign-in bypass, token tampering, other people's records, injection, guessing, sign-out, recovery codes, headers and CORS.

shots.title: What was tried
shots.caption: Every area tried and its result, from the security testing report.

shots.title: Dependencies
shots.caption: bcrypt 6 (drops tar), uuid removed, axios patched; one finding accepted with its reason.

shots.title: Conformance report
shots.caption: WCAG 2.1 AA: each criterion with its conformance and remarks; screen-reader testing still owed.
